sources.title: The Defiant — Dromos Labs merges Aerodrome and Velodrome into new DEX Aero (12 Nov 2025)
sources.excerpt: Dromos Labs, developer of Aerodrome and Velodrome, will merge them into a single DEX, Aero, launching Q2 2026 and expanding to Ethereum mainnet and Circle's Arc.

sources.title: DL News — Aerodrome devs target Uniswap with new Ethereum protocol (13 Nov 2025)
sources.excerpt: Alexander Cutler, CEO of Dromos Labs; Luis Alberto, executive director of the Aerodrome and Velodrome Foundations. Aerodrome is the largest DEX on Base, Velodrome the largest on Optimism. Oct 2025 volume: Aerodrome + Velodrome ~$26B vs Uniswap >$123B (DefiLlama). Aero to launch Q2 2026 on Ethereum first, with a bridge and a launchpad with tiers up to regulated institutions; some pools may run background checks. Foundations to fold initiatives into a 'Momentum Fund' that buys back tokens. No regulatory or legal matters reported for Aerodrome or Dromos.

sources.title: CoinDesk (via Yahoo Finance) — Aero DEX aims to fix liquidity fragmentation (29 Jan 2026)
sources.excerpt: Aerodrome TVL nearly $500M (late Jan 2026), after topping $1B in Dec 2025 when it held ~a quarter of Base TVL. Aero targeted for Q2 2026 with Ethereum expansion to compete with Uniswap and Curve; compliance tooling built in. No Coinbase investment reported.

sources.title: The Block — Aerodrome tops $1 billion in deposits, dominating DeFi on Base (3 Oct 2024)
sources.excerpt: Aerodrome launched on Base in 2023 by the Velodrome team as a fork of Velodrome (itself a Solidly ve(3,3) fork). >$1B deposits, >50% of Base DeFi TVL; largest Base DEX by TVL, volume and fees; $9.02B monthly volume (Sep 2024).

sources.title: ChainCatcher — Aerodrome domain hijacking contained, ~$700K lost (24 Nov 2025)
sources.excerpt: Attack contained in under four hours; ~$700K lost by users who connected and signed on the malicious site; MetaMask and Coinbase Wallet warnings within two minutes; Aero and Velo foundations drafting grants proportional to losses (no amounts).

active_enforcement_action.note: no lawsuit or enforcement action against Aerodrome, the Aerodrome Foundation or Dromos Labs found in press coverage reviewed (AERO-13, AERO-14, AERO-06, AERO-08). Regulator litigation databases (SEC, CFTC) were not searched directly because the search budget ran out.

aero_share_of_combined_revenue_pct.note: observed: Aerodrome $180M / (Aerodrome $180M + Velodrome $7M) yearly fees at announcement; checks claim C1
